title: A hybrid radiomics–3D CNN model using non-contrast CT for esophagogastric variceal bleeding risk prediction in cirrhosis
summary: A fusion model combining radiomics and 3D CNN features from noncontrast CT predicted esophagogastric variceal bleeding in 137 cirrhosis patients; five-fold results report mean AUC 0.884, with prospective multicenter validation still needed.
ai_technology: A fusion model combines CT radiomics and 3D CNN features to predict variceal-bleeding risk.
